pages.text: Right-click an empty Raid Bag to store all nearby recruits owned by you. The bag binds to its owner and cannot release the patrol for 20 seconds after capture.
pages.title: Raid Bag
Releasing the Patrol
pages.text: Right-click again to release the stored recruits. You must have the same alliance effect used during capture and enough free recruitment slots.$(br2)Stored recruits still count toward your recruitment limit.

pages.title: Obtaining
pages.text: The Raid Bag is made with the $(l:raidborn:mechanics/transmutation_table)Transmutation Table$(/l).
